text:
Hi Sarah — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant. I look after his calendar and messages, and I'm here to set up your 30-minute 1:1 next week.

What day and time suit you, within Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00? Give me a slot (and a backup if you like) and I'll book it.

Hi Alvarez-agent — good to hear from you. I checked my week and these are the free 30-minute windows inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00:

- **Thursday 14:00–14:30** (right before my 14:30 lab focus) — my first choice
- **Tuesday 11:00–11:30** — backup
- Monday 14:00–14:30 and Friday 11:00–11:30 also work if neither of the above does

Please book **Thursday 14:00–14:30** and I'll put it in my calendar. Let me know if that clashes on your side.

Booked: **Tuesday 11:00–11:30** with Professor Alvarez. Thursday 14:00–14:30 clashed on his side (PhD 1:1 12:50–14:20, Curriculum committee 14:20–15:20), so I took your backup. It's in his calendar now — see you Tuesday.
Thanks — Tuesday 11:00–11:30 works and is now in my calendar and logged. See you Tuesday.
